'''May 2001 Hamilton tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Hamilton, Ontario on 19 May 2001. [[Spencer Ball]] won it. It is known from Spencer Ball's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2541">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-28-ball-goes-to-hamilton-may-19th-2001d2541/ ball-goes-to-hamilton-may-19th-2001], DeckTech (Spencer "s_ skywalker" Ball, 28 June 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-28-ball-goes-to-hamilton-may-19th-2001d2541/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 19 May 2001
* '''Site:''' Hamilton, Ontario
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Spencer Ball]]
